_comment: Tier-2 for febio::rigid_body#6. A rigid body rotated 0.5 rad about x: omitting <center_of_mass> pivots it about its own geometric centre; writing <center_of_mass>0,0,5</center_of_mass> pivots it about that point and moves the body a long way; adding <override_com>1</override_com> gives a BIT-IDENTICAL result to the previous run, so the companion flag is neither needed nor effective. All three reach normal termination with exit 0 — the only detection is reading node positions back out. Executed 2026-08-06 on FEBio 4.12.0.86045466d (source build, USE_MKL=OFF). MUTATION CONTROL (2026-08-07): T2_MUTATE=1 neutralises the L.swap / L.drop edits this fixture uses to turn a correct deck into a broken one, so every deck it builds is the correct one and the pitfall is never triggered. Unmutated the fixture still PASSES; mutated it FAILS because the expectation 'center_of_mass=reproduced' is no longer printed and the forbidden token 'not_reproduced' appears. Re-verify with `cd <fixture dir> && T2_MUTATE=1 ~/Schreibtisch/open-fem-agent/.venv/bin/python source.py` (the mutation branch lives in source.py, so the proof is one command and needs no external harness).
